title: Finish the operator-facing V2 Property Intelligence workflow (Deal 81)

workstreams.name: Instant V2 Overview/Property Intelligence section switching
workstreams.operatorOutcome: Switching between V2 Overview and Property Intelligence for deal 81 feels immediate; the property record is loaded once and reused across sections; no research reruns, no stale data, no long loading animation; URL navigation and browser history keep working.
inScope: Diagnose the multi-second V2 section-switch delay (root cause required in final report)
Load or cache the active property/PI data once and reuse it across V2 sections
Prefetch PI data on Overview load only if that is the narrowest correct fix
Preserve canonical-read behavior and freshness; no stale data
Keep ?section= URL navigation and history correct
workstreams.requiredDataState: Existing Deal Card 81 / Property Card 71 (1487 Onionville Rd, Sterling NY, LandPortal 89525293) with its accepted visuals and facts; no new lead.

steps: Open http://localhost:3141/dept/acquisitions/v2?deal=81
Switch to Property Intelligence and back to Overview at least 6 times
Confirm each switch renders perceptually immediately (content visible well under a second after first load)
Confirm via network requests that tab switches do not refetch the full property record or trigger research reruns
Use browser back/forward and confirm section navigation still works
Refresh on each section and confirm correct content persists

testRequirements: Focused test that V2 section switching reuses already-loaded property data instead of refetching the full record per switch
Test that switching sections triggers no research/run mutation endpoint
Test that direct URL entry to either section still loads fresh canonical data
failureConditions: A section switch still takes multiple seconds or refetches the full property record every time
Tab switching triggers research reruns
Stale data is shown after underlying data changes
URL or history navigation breaks
The delay is hidden behind a long loading animation instead of removed

requirements.text: Overview <-> Property Intelligence switching is perceptually immediate in the live localhost workflow.
The full property record is not unnecessarily refetched or rebuilt on every section change.
Tab switching never reruns research.
Canonical-read freshness is preserved; no stale data is introduced.
URL navigation and browser history keep working for both sections.
